features.name: Toggle Radios navigation item
features.description: The sample shell lists the single scenario '1) Toggle Radios' in the navigation list and selecting it shows the scenario page.
expected_behaviour: A navigation entry titled 'Toggle Radios' (shown as '1) Toggle Radios') is visible in the left navigation list
Selecting it displays the Toggle Radios scenario page in the content area

features.name: Scenario description text
features.description: The scenario page shows a 'Description:' header and the descriptive text 'Enumerate Radios, and display toggles for each one'.
expected_behaviour: The text 'Enumerate Radios, and display toggles for each one' is visible

features.name: Radio enumeration list with per-radio toggle
features.description: On navigation the app calls Radio.RequestAccessAsync then Radio.GetRadiosAsync and adds one row (radio name + ToggleSwitch) per radio to the RadioSwitchList ItemsControl. On this machine radio access is not granted, so the list renders empty (no toggles) - the same ground-truth state must appear in the WinUI app.
expected_behaviour: A scrollable radio list area (RadioSwitchList) is present in the scenario page
One row containing the radio name and a ToggleSwitch is shown per available radio
When radio access is denied / no radios present, the list is empty (matches the UWP golden on this machine)

features.name: Status notification area
features.description: The sample shell has a 'Status:' area that shows NotifyUser messages. On this machine access is denied so it shows the error banner 'App is not allowed to control radios.'
expected_behaviour: A 'Status:' label/area is present at the bottom of the shell
When radio access is denied, an error message 'App is not allowed to control radios.' is shown
